# MedXFlow

> MedXFlow is AI revenue cycle management (RCM) and front-desk automation for medical practices, billing companies and RCM teams. AI agents run eligibility, prior authorization, coding, claims, denial management and patient collections, plus a 24/7 AI receptionist, self check-in and telehealth, integrated with Epic, athenahealth and eClinicalWorks. PHI is handled to HIPAA standards with a BAA available and SOC 2-aligned controls.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://medxflow.ai/): What MedXFlow does across the revenue cycle and front desk.
- [AI agents for RCM](https://medxflow.ai/ai-agents-rcm/): How the AI agents work the revenue cycle end to end.
- [Products](https://medxflow.ai/products/): The MedXFlow product suite for RCM and the AI front desk.
- [Specialties](https://medxflow.ai/specialties/): RCM and automation by medical specialty.
- [Telehealth](https://medxflow.ai/telehealth/): AI-assisted telehealth visits and intake.
- [About](https://medxflow.ai/about/): Who MedXFlow is and how the platform is built.
- [Trust and security](https://medxflow.ai/trust/): HIPAA, BAA, SOC 2-aligned controls, encryption and audit logging.

- [Denial rate calculator](https://medxflow.ai/denial-rate-calculator/): Estimate the revenue lost to claim denials.

- [Denial codes](https://medxflow.ai/denial-codes/): CARC and RARC denial code explanations and next actions.
